description: Defines the UserAuthProvider entity class with properties and methods for user authentication providers, including LDAP and local types, using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: UserAuthProvider
classes.description: Entity class representing user authentication providers, supporting local and LDAP types, with properties for LDAP details and associated user.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the auth provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the auth provider.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this auth provider.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the provider type (local or LDAP).

methods.name: getLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: setLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: getLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user unique ID.

methods.name: setLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user unique ID.
